name: The Dignity of the Dead: a cleared Weed or Snow Pile credits once and disappears (#11792)
contract: The Dignity of the Dead (quest 175170) asks for 6 Weeds (gameobject 2300710, objective index 0) and 6 Snow Piles (gameobject 2300711, objective index 1) cleared in Snowveil Cemetery. Each pile is authored as a consumable goober (Data5 1).

With an auto-close time of 0 the goober was never marked in use, so a cleared pile gave progress and stayed, as reported. Each pile here is the actor's own summoned copy of the template, used twice in a row with no wait.
Expected: the first use of each pile credits 1; the second use of the same pile is rejected, so its counter stays 1; the used pile then disappears. Before the repair the pile stays.

steps.label: SETUP: no Snow Pile cleared yet
SETUP: one Weed grows by the keeper
Click the same Weed again at once
SETUP: the first pull credits the quest
DISCRIMINATING: the same Weed credits only once
SETUP: one Snow Pile lies by the keeper
Click the same Snow Pile again at once
SETUP: the first clearing credits the quest
DISCRIMINATING: the same Snow Pile credits only once
DISCRIMINATING: the cleared Snow Pile disappears
